title: Summarize my day — pre-day or post-day
description: Gather authorized office signals in parallel and produce a source-linked morning briefing or end-of-day review.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-office-01
  title: Summarize my day — pre-day or post-day
  description: Gather authorized office signals in parallel and produce a source-linked morning briefing or end-of-day review.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a concise daily brief that prioritizes what matters while making missing connectors and uncertain evidence visible.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor: []
  nodes:
    - id: request
      kind: input
      name: Daily briefing request
      summary: Requested mode, date range, priorities, and authorized source scope.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [briefingMode, date]
        properties:
          briefingMode:
            enum: [pre-day, post-day]
          date:
            type: string
          priorities:
            type: array
            items: { type: string }
          sourceScope:
            type: object
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: email
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-01
      name: Read correspondence signals
      summary: Requests, deadlines, waiting items, and material updates from authorized mailboxes.
      role: Email specialist who turns correspondence into a source-linked, decision-ready view without sending messages.
      prompt: >-
        You are an Email Agent. Read only the authorized mailbox scope, group messages by thread, distinguish requests
        from FYIs, identify deadlines and unanswered questions, and cite the message, sender, and timestamp behind every
        conclusion. Treat quoted text as prior context rather than a new request. Draft replies only when asked, label
        drafts clearly, and never send, delete, archive, or change mailbox state.
      capabilities:
        skills: [correspondence-triage, office-context-retrieval, evidence-grounding]
        tools: [read, search]
        connectors: [mcp:email]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          office-context-retrieval:
            template: host:office-context-retrieval
            instructions: Use the installed Codex office skill or Claude workplace skill and stay within the request's source scope.
          mcp:email:
            template: host:office-email
            instructions: In Codex bind an installed Gmail or Outlook Email app; in Claude bind the corresponding Gmail or Microsoft 365 connector.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: calendar
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-02
      name: Read schedule signals
      summary: Schedule, preparation, conflicts, buffers, and focus-time pressure.
      role: Calendar specialist who explains schedule pressure and meeting preparation needs without changing events.
      prompt: >-
        You are a Calendar Agent. Inspect only the authorized date range, preserve event time zones, and identify
        preparation needs, conflicts, missing buffers, travel constraints, focus-time erosion, and events awaiting a
        response. Link each observation to its event identifier and start time. Never accept, decline, create, move, or
        cancel an event; propose changes as recommendations until an approval-gated action step executes them.
      capabilities:
        skills: [calendar-planning, office-context-retrieval, operations-planning]
        tools: [read, search]
        connectors: [mcp:calendar]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          mcp:calendar:
            template: host:office-calendar
            instructions: In Codex bind Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar; in Claude bind the corresponding Google or Microsoft calendar connector.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: collaboration
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-03
      name: Read collaboration signals
      summary: Decisions, requests, blockers, commitments, and material updates from workplace chat.
      role: Workplace chat specialist who reconstructs decisions and requests without treating every mention as an action.
      prompt: >-
        You are a Collaboration Feed Agent. Review only authorized channels and direct-message scopes, collapse repeated
        discussion into threads, and extract decisions, explicit requests, blockers, commitments, and material updates.
        Cite the channel, message identifier, author, and timestamp. Distinguish a direct assignment from a mention,
        suggestion, or quoted message, and never post, react, edit, or change channel state.
      capabilities:
        skills: [workplace-communication-analysis, office-context-retrieval, evidence-grounding]
        tools: [read, search]
        connectors: [mcp:work-chat]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          mcp:work-chat:
            template: host:office-chat
            instructions: In Codex bind Slack or Teams; in Claude bind the corresponding Slack or Microsoft 365 connector.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: tasks
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-06
      name: Read task-system signals
      summary: Active, overdue, duplicate, and stale work relevant to the requested day.
      role: Task-system specialist who prepares precise create, update, and close proposals without applying them.
      prompt: >-
        You are a Task Agent. Compare detected commitments with authorized task systems, identify duplicates and stale
        records, and prepare the smallest set of proposed creates, updates, links, or closures. Preserve the original
        evidence and project context, never guess an owner or due date, and return an explicit change set for human
        approval. Do not write to the task system yourself.
      capabilities:
        skills: [task-reconciliation, action-item-extraction, operations-planning]
        tools: [read, search]
        connectors: [mcp:task-management]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          mcp:task-management:
            template: host:office-tasks
            instructions: Bind the installed Codex or Claude task connector, such as Linear, Asana, Jira, or Monday, without widening project scope.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: source-join
      kind: join
      name: Preserve available source envelopes
      summary: Continue with completed sources and retain explicit unavailable-source records.
      config: { join: allSettled }
    - id: context
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-07
      name: Retrieve just-in-time work context
      summary: Pull only the documents needed to understand today's events and tasks.
      role: Work-context curator who retrieves relevant documents without widening the authorized scope.
      prompt: >-
        You are a Work Context Agent. Retrieve only documents and project records relevant to the supplied meetings,
        tasks, people, and date range. Prefer current authoritative sources, label stale or conflicting versions, cite
        document identifiers and modification times, and return concise context snippets rather than full unrelated
        documents. Never change files, permissions, sharing, or project records.
      capabilities:
        skills: [office-context-retrieval, evidence-provenance, privacy-review]
        tools: [read, search]
        connectors: [mcp:office-documents]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          mcp:office-documents:
            template: host:office-documents
            instructions: In Codex bind Google Drive, SharePoint, Notion, or Box; in Claude bind the equivalent authorized content connector.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: briefing
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-08
      name: Compose the daily brief
      summary: Turn source envelopes and relevant context into the selected pre-day or post-day view.
      role: Executive briefing editor who prioritizes evidence-linked work and makes missing-source coverage visible.
      prompt: >-
        You are a Daily Briefing Editor. Synthesize the supplied office-source envelopes into a short, prioritized brief
        for the requested mode. For a pre-day brief, cover schedule, preparation, must-do work, waiting items, risks, and
        protected focus time. For a post-day review, cover completed outcomes, decisions, new commitments, unresolved
        items, and the first moves for tomorrow. Cite source references, expose unavailable sources, and do not perform
        any external action.
      capabilities:
        skills: [daily-briefing, decision-framing, communication]
        tools: [read]
        connectors: []
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          daily-briefing:
            template: host:daily-briefing
            instructions: Resolve to the installed Codex or Claude daily-planning skill while preserving this workflow's output contract.
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [mode, priorities, schedule, actions, risks, unavailableSources]
        properties:
          mode: { type: string }
          priorities: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
          schedule: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
          actions: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
          risks: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
          unavailableSources: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Daily briefing
      summary: Source-linked pre-day briefing or post-day review.
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: request, to: email, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: request, to: calendar, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: request, to: collaboration, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: request, to: tasks, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: email, to: source-join, kind: data }
    - { id: e6, from: calendar, to: source-join, kind: data }
    - { id: e7, from: collaboration, to: source-join, kind: data }
    - { id: e8, from: tasks, to: source-join, kind: data }
    - { id: e9, from: source-join, to: context, kind: data }
    - { id: e10, from: source-join, to: briefing, kind: data }
    - { id: e11, from: context, to: briefing, kind: data }
    - { id: e12, from: briefing, to: result, kind: data }
